This setting appears when you are on a list page **with page numbers**. You can set how many pages to crawl.

?> Gray text is displayed on the right side of this setting, indicating the range of numbers you can enter. These ranges may differ on different pages.

The downloader always starts crawling **from the current page** (including the current page). If you are on page 1, the downloader will start crawling from page 1. If you are on page 2, it will start from page 2.

- Setting it to 1 will only crawl the works on this page.
- Setting it to 2 will crawl this page and the next page, and so on.
- Setting it to -1 will make the downloader crawl from this page to the last page.

If you need to, you can **split** a task that crawls a large number of pages **into multiple tasks**. For example:

- Set the number of pages to crawl to 100, then start crawling from page 1. The downloader will crawl the works on pages 1 - 100.
- After the download finishes, jump to page 101 and start the next crawl. The downloader will crawl the works on pages 101 - 200.
- And so on.
